parameters.help_en: The trigger configuration of the scheduled task. The triggerMode parameter supports manual (manual trigger) and scheduled (scheduled trigger). If scheduled is used, the cron parameter must be specified. The timezone and language parameters are injected by the server, and the client does not need to pass them. The pushConfig parameter is the list of task push channels. If the list is empty or no channel is enabled, no push is performed
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务触发配置。triggerMode 支持 manual（人工触发）和 scheduled（定时触发）；使用 scheduled 时须填写 cron。timezone 和 language 由服务端注入，客户端可不传。pushConfig 为任务推送频道列表；为空或无启用频道时不推送

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration group to which the task belongs, such as cg_101. If this parameter is passed, a group space task is created, and the caller must be a valid group member. If this parameter is empty, a personal task is created
parameters.help_zh: 所属协作群组 ID（如 cg_101）；传入时创建群空间任务（调用者需为有效群成员），为空创建个人任务
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The visibility scope of the group task. Valid values: PRIVATE (visible only to the creator and group owner), COLLABORATIVE (visible to specified collaboration members), and PUBLIC (visible to all group members). If this parameter is not passed for a group task, the default value is PRIVATE. This field is ignored for personal tasks
parameters.help_zh: 群任务可见范围：PRIVATE(仅创建人与群主可见)/COLLABORATIVE(指定协作成员可见)/PUBLIC(群内全员可见)；群任务不传时默认 PRIVATE，个人任务忽略该字段
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The list of user IDs of collaboration members. This parameter takes effect only when visibility is set to COLLABORATIVE and is ignored for other values. A maximum of 1,000 user IDs can be specified. You do not need to pass the IDs of the task creator and group creator because they are covered by the authentication layer. This field is ignored for personal tasks
parameters.help_zh: 协作成员用户 ID 列表（仅 visibility=COLLABORATIVE 生效，其余档位忽略，最多 1000 个）；任务创建人与群创建人无需传入（由鉴权层覆盖）；个人任务忽略该字段
parameters.name: visible_member_user_ids
